content: Hello, you've reached the Community Club support desk. How can I assist you today regarding your membership or annual fees?
Hi, I just paid my annual fee for Hillview Club using Zelle, but I need confirmation. My member ID is 44827, and the payment was $120.
Thank you, Mr. Daniel Freitas. I see a Zelle transaction for $120 received today at 9:55 AM, reference code ZL-9862B1, under the email dfreitas92@gmail.com. Is that the correct email you used?
Yes, that's my email. I sent it from my Wells Fargo account and included '2024 dues' in the note.

Perfect, Daniel. The note '2024 dues' matches our records, and your Wells Fargo transfer to our club's account (ending in 7431) has been logged. Let me update your profile to reflect payment for member ID 44827.
Great, can I get a receipt sent to my email? I need it for work reimbursement, and the deadline is tomorrow.

Of course, timing is important! A payment confirmation for $120, Zelle code ZL-9862B1, will be emailed to dfreitas92@gmail.com within the next 10 minutes. If you need a PDF copy or prefer it sent to a different address, just let me know.
No, that's perfect. Thanks for being so prompt!

You're welcome, Daniel! Your membership is now fully active through June 2025. If you need any further documentation or a statement with your full address at 857 Hawthorne Ave, just reach out. Have a great day!
